title: The Asset of the Green Zone
author: Ulyana Sterling
blurb: Paloma Pemberton, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
